newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.KOREA DENIES REPORT ON FOREIGN STOCK CEILING.
newsitem.headline: S.KOREA DENIES REPORT ON FOREIGN STOCK CEILING.

text.p: South Korea's finance ministry on Monday denied a news report that it would raise the foreign stock ownership limit as early as October.
"We have not mentioned about the timing of the limit expansion," said an official at the ministry's securities division.
The ministry has said the limit would be raised to 25-26 percent this year from the current 23 percent.
A domestic newspaper said the ministry was considering raising the limit in October to offset any adverse effects from the listing of Korea Telecom scheduled in the month.
